closeGame: Close STFC when convenient. Daystrom will finish restoring the previous mod automatically, and it will take effect the next time you start the game.
finishingMod: Daystrom is finishing the restored mod for the next game start.
description: Use recovery only if the current Daystrom release causes problems. This restores Daystrom and its bundled mod to the previous verified release, {{version}}.
runningGame: STFC stays open. A mod already loaded by the running game changes only after the game is closed and started again.
installing: Restoring the previous release and restarting Daystrom…
none: No verified previous Daystrom release is available.
